about: The engine as it stood on 2026-11-15, kept as the starting point (R-491): his earlier marks are history and the engine is no longer held to them, so this is what later engines are compared with. The engine is kept as the branch baseline-2026-11-15 (commit fd2b30b of bundle-4). The file 2026-11-15-plays.json.gz beside this one is that engine's full output on the development set (`moments.py all <file> --dev`): every moment, every play with its job and result. To compare a later engine: run the same command, then set the two files side by side (plays by kind below; `tools/golden/review.py compare` for one game).
